description: ParcelPal 1.2.7 remote-update edition. Taobao sync uses per-run diagnostics, one page lock, and official WebView timeouts so a hung load cannot leave the button spinning. Does not guarantee proxy connectivity. Auth and keys unchanged.
name: 包裹助手（远程更新）

localizedDescriptions.zh: 1.2.7 远程更新版：淘宝同步按轮次记录诊断，同一时间只开一轮页面；加载使用官方超时，结束后按钮会收回。不保证代理网络一定能连上。登录与密钥逻辑未改。
localizedDescriptions.en: 1.2.7 remote-update edition. Taobao sync keeps per-run diagnostics and one page at a time. Loads use the official timeout, and the button resets when the round ends. This does not guarantee proxy connectivity. Auth and keys unchanged.
